company.name: Legal Advice Middle East
company.shortDescription: Legal Advice Middle East is an AI-powered legal services marketplace connecting consumers and lawyers online.
company.description: Legal Advice Middle East is a Dubai-based LegalTech platform founded in 2015 that helps users access legal advice, lawyer directories, legal consultations, and legal resources online across the Middle East region. The platform allows consumers to ask legal questions, connect with licensed lawyers, request consultations, and access services such as legal document drafting, business formation support, and legal research. It also provides multilingual support, remote legal assistance, and a knowledge base featuring legal articles, laws, and FAQs tailored to regional legal systems.
